description: This file contains the implementation of the RawPngData class, which provides methods for indexing into raw PNG byte array data to extract pixel values, including support for palettes and various color types.

classes.name: RawPngData
classes.description: A class offering utilities for accessing pixel data from a raw PNG byte array, supporting different color types, bit depths, and palettes.

methods.name: GetPixelIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the pixel at (x, y), considering palette indices if applicable.

methods.name: GetPixel
methods.description: Returns the Pixel object at coordinates (x, y), interpreting raw byte data according to image format.

methods.name: ToSingleByte
methods.description: Converts two bytes into a single byte value scaled from 16-bit to 8-bit range.
